decisions.reason: The large bulk container was launched recently, has its own page and fits the firm's core reusable packaging range, so its value is still uncertain while keeping it costs little, which argues for keeping the option open.
The valve is a low-cost accessory that complements the bulk containers and has its own page, and too little evidence has come in after one year to justify dropping it.

The take-back service is only mentioned on the website, so it carries more uncertainty, but it supports the firm's move toward circular, service-based offerings and is cheap to keep, so it stays while results come in.
